A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Light Forcing study and contain readable main text, Figures 1–10, Tables 1–11, and Appendices A–J. The longer bibliography in v4 shifts appendix pagination without removing material.

before.justification: v2 reports original video-generation evaluations, component ablations, sensitivity analyses, and GPU latency and memory measurements in Section 5 and the appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experimental results, including VBench and VBench-Long comparisons, ablations, and hardware measurements.

M1.justification: CAG sparsity allocation and HSA token compression, frame/block selection, and attention computation remain unchanged. The block-count notation edit in Section 4.2 does not change the procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same 5-second and 15-second video-generation coverage using VBench and VBench-Long, with the same qualitative prompts and scenarios in the appendices.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding tables, including TeaCache and DyCoke in Table 8. Section 5.2 corrects 'SVG' to 'SVG2', matching the Yang et al. (2025b) comparator already identified in Table 1 and Appendix A.

E3.justification: Both retain the same experimental settings, including 2,000 post-training iterations, three-frame chunks, 512×768 resolution, block size 64, duration-specific sparsity settings, evaluation metrics, and hardware timing procedures.

E4.justification: The component ablation in Table 3, retrieved-frame sensitivity analysis in Table 4, qualitative ablations in Appendix F, and latency and memory analyses in Appendix H are retained without changes.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged: both present point estimates without seed summaries, error bars, confidence intervals, or significance tests. Appendix H.1 retains the same single-video timing description after warm-up.

E6.justification: Reported numerical results and qualitative examples are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains Light Forcing's total scores and latencies of 84.5 and 7.39 seconds on Self Forcing, and 83.9 and 8.81 seconds on LongLive. The appendix comparison, latency, and memory tables also retain their values.

T1.justification: The mathematical content of Equations 1–21 and the conditional KL/TV derivation in Appendix C is unchanged. Replacing N_q and N_kv with n_q and n_kv in Section 4.2 merely renames the same block counts.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same novelty claim, CAG and HSA contributions, and claims about generation quality, acceleration, and real-time deployment.

C2.justification: Interpretations of error propagation, the CAG motion tradeoff, HSA's benefits, and memory behavior are unchanged. Appendix J retains the same limitations concerning model scale, residual artifacts, GPU-specific optimization, and further acceleration.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, baseline adaptations, prompts, hardware and kernel information, Docker identifier, and code/checkpoint links remain unchanged. The updated arXiv version hyperlink does not change reproducibility resources.

R1.justification: Appendix G adds eight citations spanning quantization, cross-modal hashing, clustering, and detection, with corresponding bibliography entries. These accompany the existing introduction to other acceleration methods without additional technical discussion or a revision of the main related-work positioning.

P1.justification: Scattered edits add 'clean' to the generated-chunk description, harmonize block-count notation, and correct 'SVG' to 'SVG2'. The Consistency Models reference gains publication details. Section organization and the surrounding narrative remain substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures and tables retain their contents, structures, and captions. Added bibliography entries produce another reference page and shift appendix pagination; the citation insertion also slightly reflows Appendix G across a page boundary.

improvement.justification: v4 provides slight editorial polish through the SVG2 correction and notation consistency, while retaining the same method, proof, experimental evidence, reproducibility information, and limitations. Appendix G's additional citations receive no substantive discussion. These changes do not meaningfully alter the paper's overall quality.
